name: Geomechanics
notes: A four-year program offered jointly by Earth and Environmental Sciences and Mechanical Engineering.
MATH 161 and MATH 162 can be replaced with MATH 141-143.
This major explicitly requires TWO clusters, one in the social sciences and one in the humanities, for six additional courses.
Three free electives are expected, to allow a strong minor or to broaden the curriculum - not modeled as requirements.
One technical elective may come from any discipline, as agreed with the faculty advisor - modeled as an EESC/ME course since the app cannot represent advisor approval.
The page writes 'EES 225: Seismic Signals and Noise'; the catalog department prefix is EESC, which is the form used here.

requirementGroups.label: Mathematics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: MATH 161: Calculus IA; MATH 162: Calculus IIA; MATH 164: Multidimensional Calculus; MATH 165: Linear Algebra with Differential Equations. MATH 161 and MATH 162 can be replaced with MATH 141-143.

requirementGroups.label: Physics and chemistry
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PHYS 099: Intro Math Methods in Science and Engineering; PHYS 121: Mechanics; PHYS 122: Electricity and Magnetism; CHEM 131: Chemistry Concepts, Systems, Practice I

requirementGroups.label: Earth science core
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: EESC 101: Introduction to Earth Sciences; EESC 201: Evolution of the Earth; EESC 204W: Earth Minerals; EESC 224: Geomechanics

requirementGroups.label: Mechanical engineering core
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: ME 120: Mechanical Engineering Mechanics I; ME 123: Introduction to Thermodynamics; ME 160: Engineering Computation I; ME 225: Introduction to Fluid Dynamics; ME 226: Introduction to Solid Mechanics

requirementGroups.label: Instrumentation or seismic signals
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus one of the following: ME 240: Fundamentals of Instrumentation and Measurement (recommended); ME 241: Mechanics Laboratory (prerequisite ME 240); EES 225: Seismic Signals and Noise

requirementGroups.label: Technical electives from EESC or ME (4)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus four technical electives from any EESC or ME courses at the 200 level or higher

requirementGroups.label: Technical elective, any discipline
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus one technical elective from any discipline, as agreed upon with the faculty advisor
requirementGroups.note: Advisor approval cannot be represented; modeled as a related technical course.

upperLevelWriting.label: Two upper-level writing courses within the major
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: Two of the courses for the major must be taken as upper-level writing courses, indicated by a 'W' after the course number.
